name: Italia overworld
description: Glory of Rome: the Italia province map, classic 16-bit RPG overworld
caption: A classic 16-bit RPG overworld map of Roman Italy in three-quarter top-down view: grey limestone mountains, a walled hill town with terracotta roofs, umbrella pines and dark cypresses, a blue river with a stone arch bridge, a paved Roman road, ploughed and wheat fields, a sandy beach and turquoise sea, a small rider on the road. Clean pixel art, dark outlines on objects, soft shading, warm sunlight from the upper left.
llm_instructions: Describe the subject as it would appear on a classic 16-bit RPG overworld map of Roman Italy, seen from the three-quarter top-down view (the top and the south face of things are visible, ground is seen from above). Keep the warm Mediterranean palette: fresh green grass, grey limestone, terracotta roofs, golden wheat, turquoise sea, sandy beaches. Light comes from the upper left. Objects have clean dark outlines and soft shading. Name a plain flat background colour when the subject is a single object; describe the ground when the subject is a terrain texture. Never add text, borders, grid lines, frames, sky or a horizon.
